What the code contains: `platform` is a Python project with 309 module(s), 81 HTTP endpoint(s), a command line (`backend/src/hmap/agents/docgen/compile_report.py`, `backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/host.py`, `infra/observability/load/soak.py`) and 109 test file(s). Its main parts are `env`, `hmap`, `build_dashboard`, `soak`, `cloud_check`, `demo_chaos`, `demo_preflight`, `demo_sprint_1`.
Summary of the code: The platform is a hierarchical multi‑agent AI execution system (hmap) that orchestrates agents for document ingestion, refinement, research, coding, testing and documentation across a series of sprint demos. Core configuration and error handling live in `backend/src/hmap/core/config.py` and `backend/src/hmap/core/errors.py`, while the FastAPI entry point `backend/src/hmap/api/app.py` exposes the HTTP endpoints used by all demos. Agents communicate via contracts defined in files such as `backend/src/hmap/core/contracts/domain.py` and `backend/src/hmap/core/contracts/capabilities.py`, and the runtime discovers plug‑ins through `backend/src/hmap/core/runtime/discovery.py`. Supporting tools like the load‑soak runner (`infra/observability/load/soak.py`) and the dashboard generator (`backend/src/hmap/agents/docgen/compile_report.py`) provide observability and reporting for the platform’s operation.
